                                                                                  We introduced UniSplat, a feed-forward framework that
                                                                                  learns unified 3D representations directly from unposed
for geometry and rendering. Geometry-aware dual mask                              multi-view images. UniSplat addresses the key limita-
and coarse-to-fine Gaussians splatting strategy yield con-                        tions of prior methods through three complementary com-
sistent gains. Disabling self-supervised learning for appear-                     ponents: a dual-masking strategy that strengthens geometry
ance degrades all metrics.                                                        induction by enforcing structure reasoning from incomplete
Scale Up with More Training Data. Table 6 demon-                                  cues, a coarse-to-fine Gaussian splatting strategy that pro-
strates that expanding the training dataset can significantly                     gressively refines scene appearance to capture both global
enhance model generalization and robustness. Larger, di-                          structure and fine detail, and a pose-conditioned recalibra-
verse datasets expose the model to varied patterns, reducing                      tion mechanism that enforces geometric–semantic consis-
overfitting and improving performance on unseen data.                             tency by aligning multi-head predictions in a shared spatial
Ablation on the Number of Input Views. As shown in Ta-                            frame. Together, these designs enable UniSplat to produce
ble 7, increasing input views improves both segmentation                          coherent, high-fidelity 3D representations that are robust to
and reconstruction. More views provide richer geometric                           sparse-view settings and transferable across domains. Ex-
and appearance cues, enhancing scene understanding and                            tensive experiments on both 3D vision benchmarks and em-
rendering quality. Gains diminish beyond 8 views, indi-                           bodied AI tasks confirm its effectiveness and versatility.
